profile.headline: Software Development Engineer in Test
profile.summary:
Software QA automation engineer with proficient knowledge in C#, Java, JavaScript, Node.JS with focus in building Web and Mobile test automation framework using Selenium WebDriver.

Work Experience:
-Maintain test automation framework and scripts using Java, Selenium, JavaScript, Node.JS, WebDriverIO, Mocha, Chai for OnPrem Solution Partners as a QA Automation Engineer consultant for FMC on OTMM platform.
-Build test automation framework and infrastructure for CI environment, using C#, Selenium WebDriver, Selenium Grid, ExtentReports and Jenkins for SmallWorldCommunity at PersonifyCorp.
-Plan, create manage and execute test cases/suites for various components of the project based on behavior specs and marketing requirements for Dell Openmanage Essentials & Mobile projects.
-Analyze test results and submit, meticulously detailed behavioral and functional defects with reproduction steps and track/regress bug fixes.
-Create/maintain various hardware, software and OS test configuration environments based support matrix.

Knowledge and Skills:
-C#, Java, JavaScript, Node.JS
-Selenium WebDriver, WebDriverIO, RemoteWebDriver
-Mocha, Chai
-Selenium Grid
-Jenkins
-Postman
-Appium, Selendroid
-NUnit, TestNG
-ExtentReports
-JIRA Administration, TestFLO for JIRA

Hypervisor server cluster mgmt tools:
-Windows Hyper-V/Core HA Cluster
-Windows SCVMM 2012 R2
-Microsoft SQL Server Failover Cluster
-PowerShell 3.0
-VMware HA Cluster
-VMware vSphere Client
-vCenter Server
-vSphere CLI
-vCenter Server Converter Standalone (P2V)

Storage configuration and management:
-Dell Equal Logic iSCSI SAN, MD Array, MDSM, RAID, Microsoft CSV

Networking device config and mgmt:
-Link Aggregate Control Protocol, VLAN, MTU config for iSCSI SAN (Jumbo Packets), LBFO NIC Teaming.

Software and OS:
-Windows Server 2008/2012/R2/Core, Hyper-V/Core
-Microsoft SQL Server
-RHEL, CentOS
-Mac OS

Network Mgmt and Communication Protocols:
-TCP/IP, SNMP, IPMI, WMI, WS-Man, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, HTTP(S), FTP, SSH, Telnet

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Contract at Baxter International (Cary, NC)

Maintain iOS and Android Mobile test suite using C#, NUnit, Selenium, Appium.
Commit code changes, create Github action runs for tests, create pull requests, perform code reviews in Github.
Create/Close bugs and tasks in Jira.
Manage cloud resource in Azure DevOps.
Sync automated test cases with test steps detailed in Jama.

positions.description: Consult with QA team on best practices for implementing and integrating test automation framework with a CI/CD build pipelines running in a Cloud environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Documentation · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Bug Tracking · Software Testing

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (Build Engineer)
positions.description:
Execute build script on two-week sprint cycle.
Coordinate with various team members to schedule and execute one-off builds.
Maintain and update existing build script.
Maintain build infrastructure.
Maintain and update build pipelines in Azure DevOps.

Completed projects:
Port build script from NANT (.XML) to Cake Build (C#) scripts.
Migrated build infrastructure from local Hyper-V to GCP (Google Cloud Platform).
Added feature to existing C# project: generate build release notes in excel format.
Migrate project data from Microsoft TFS to Azure DevOps.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Documentation · Microsoft Azure · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Code Review · Bug Tracking · .NET Framework · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (SDET)
positions.description:
• Build a web UI Automation framework, from ground up, integrated with Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for a multi-tenant construction project management SaaS product.
• Automation framework is written in CSharp with Selenium Webdriver.
• Framework has the ability to execute test cases on various OS platforms and browser combinations on the local machine for unit testing or on a Zalenium docker instance (elastic Selenium Grid Hub/Node)
• Framework design levages polymorphism in order to have the ability to execute the same testcase(s) against multiple tenants, where the tenant sites have variances of the same component/modules. (E.g. Navigation menu with different names navigating to the same component page, Component pages with different required input fields, etc.)
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Documentation · Selenium Grid · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Code Review · Bug Tracking · Test Automation · .NET Framework · Software Testing

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Build and maintain test automation framework for web-based community platform (SmallWorldLabs.com) using C#, Selenium WebDriver, Selenium Grid and Extent Reports. 
Automate and maintain test scripts with reporting functions for BVT and Regression test suites.
Build and maintain private cloud test infrastructure VMs using Selenium-Grid, running on Windows Hyper-V server.
Maintain test projects in Jenkins with JIRA integration.
Collaborate in development of test plans and test cases using TestFLO in JIRA .

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Test module owner for OpenManage Mobile project.
Create and maintain test suites and execute test cases for OpenManage Essentials and OpenManage Mobile projects.
Analyze test execution results and submit detailed defects with steps for defect reproduction.
Track and update defects and regress defect fixes.
Create and maintain various hardware and system configuration environments.
Write technical documentation and create tutorial videos for OpenManage Essentials. (Dell TechCenter links below)
Participate in providing technical resolution for on-site field technicians and Dell TechCenter forum questions for OpenManage Essentials and OpenManage Mobile applications and update, create new test cases or submit change request user stories based on related field issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Documentation · Selenium Grid · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Bug Tracking · JIRA · .NET Framework · Software Testing

positions.title: Software Test Analyst
positions.description:
Create and maintain various hardware and system configurations in test environments.
Execute test cases for Symantec's core application for Dell Management Console.
Work with Dell QA engineers to analyze test results and provide technical feedback on behavior.
